reviews.scope: Compared the published funding history with the company announcement and checked public records for earlier lettered rounds and closure. The reviewed history places Series A in 2022.

Compared the earlier seed and its proposed follow-on with the liquidators’ initial business and shareholder account and the official Companies Register. Checked public reports for completed priced lettered financing through the liquidation date.

Checked later financing searches and public operating announcements. The March company activity establishes follow-up. The subsequent UK project funding report describes a possible future Series A separately.
Checked issuer seed release, NZX portfolio addition, investor case and dated operating coverage; later labelled financing remains unverified.
Compared NZTE’s first raise with public sources covering later financing and operations. The dated university account is the latest positively identified operating report in this review.
Checked the public funding reports, the issuer newsroom and later named funding. This follow-up uses the agreement, with product availability still pending as of that source.
Checked venture and trade reports of seed financing, issuer activity and later funding searches. Government support is a distinct funding source.
Checked financing announcements, trade reporting, the issuer media index and later funding searches; a priced outcome remains unverified.
Checked original seed and Shearwater’s unlabelled follow-on alongside the company’s operating updates and later funding searches.

Reviewed investor descriptions of the pre-Series A, launch reporting, company evidence of usage revenue and public searches for lettered financing. Device-version correspondence and first payment remain unresolved.
Checked the issuer’s news, public award evidence and funding searches. The latest dated signal used in this review is a grant, distinct from a priced financing outcome.
